description: Stage-precedence directed graph for Indian RCC-frame residential construction. Used by the trajectory-fitting module to constrain stage inference.

stages.label: Excavation
stages.description: Pit dug to required depth and width. Soil removed, dimensions verified.

stages.label: PCC / Blinding Layer
stages.description: Plain cement concrete levelling course poured. Becomes invisible once footing rebar is placed and concrete poured.

stages.label: Footing Rebar Placement
stages.description: Reinforcement bars (TMT) tied in footing configuration. Becomes permanently invisible after concrete pour.

stages.label: Footing Concrete Pour
stages.description: Footing concrete poured and consolidated. Surface visible briefly; then buried by backfill.

stages.label: Backfill
stages.description: Earth returned around footings. Footing itself now permanently concealed.

stages.label: Column Pedestal / Stub
stages.description: Short column stub rising from footing to plinth level. Visible above ground.

stages.label: Column Rebar Placement
stages.description: Vertical reinforcement bars and stirrups placed. Invisible after concrete pour.

stages.label: Column Formwork
stages.description: Shuttering erected around column rebar. Rebar becomes invisible at this stage.

stages.label: Column Concrete Pour
stages.description: Concrete poured into column formwork. Formwork visible; internal rebar permanently concealed.

stages.label: Column Deshuttered
stages.description: Formwork removed. Concrete column exposed; surface finish and quality visible.

stages.label: Column Cured
stages.description: Curing process completed (7–28 days). Column ready to carry load.

stages.label: Centering / Shuttering
stages.description: Temporary supports and formwork erected for slab and beam.

stages.label: Beam / Slab Rebar
stages.description: Steel reinforcement placed for beams and slab (main bars, distribution bars, beam stirrups). Becomes invisible after concrete.

stages.label: MEP Rough-in (in slab)
stages.description: Conduit and plumbing sleeves placed within slab formwork before pour. Permanently concealed.

stages.label: Slab Concrete Pour
stages.description: Concrete poured, levelled, and compacted. Top surface visible; bottom and rebar concealed.

stages.label: Slab Deshuttered
stages.description: Centering removed. Slab soffit exposed; overall RCC frame now visible.

stages.label: Wall Layout
stages.description: Wall positions marked; first course of bricks laid.

stages.label: Full Brickwork
stages.description: All walls brought to full height. Visible until plastered.

stages.label: MEP Chasing / Conduit
stages.description: Channels cut in brickwork for electrical conduits and plumbing pipes. Concealed by plaster.

stages.label: Internal Plaster
stages.description: Internal wall surfaces plastered. Brickwork, chases, and conduits permanently concealed.

stages.label: External Plaster
stages.description: External facades plastered. Brickwork permanently concealed externally.

stages.label: Floor Screed / Bed
stages.description: Cement mortar bed laid over slab. Concealed by final floor finish.

stages.label: Floor Tiling
stages.description: Ceramic or porcelain tiles laid. Screed bed concealed.

stages.label: Vitrified Tile Flooring
stages.description: Vitrified tiles laid. Premium finish. Screed bed concealed.

stages.label: Marble / Granite Flooring
stages.description: Natural stone slabs fixed. Screed bed concealed.

stages.label: Conduit & Wiring
stages.description: PVC conduits and electrical wires run through chased walls and slab. Permanently concealed by plaster.

stages.label: Distribution Board
stages.description: MCB distribution board installed. Wiring connections made.

stages.label: Electrical Fixtures
stages.description: Switches, sockets, light fittings installed.

stages.label: Underground Plumbing
stages.description: Drainage and supply pipes laid below slab level. Concealed by slab pour and backfill.

stages.label: Plumbing Risers / Wall Pipes
stages.description: Vertical supply and drainage pipes run. Concealed by brickwork and plaster.

stages.label: Sanitary Fixtures
stages.description: WCs, basins, taps, geysers installed.

stages.label: Roof Waterproofing
stages.description: Waterproofing membrane or treatment applied over roof slab. Concealed by screed and tiles.

stages.label: Roof Screed / Slope
stages.description: Sloped screed over waterproofing for drainage. Concealed by terrace finish.

stages.label: Terrace / Roof Finish
stages.description: China mosaic, paver blocks, or roof tiles laid. Waterproofing permanently concealed.

stages.label: Wall Putty
stages.description: Putty applied over internal plaster. Concealed by paint.

stages.label: Internal Paint
stages.description: Primer and finish paint coats applied to internal walls. Final visual surface.

stages.label: External Paint / Cladding
stages.description: External facade painted or clad. Final building exterior visible.

stages.label: Woodwork / Carpentry
stages.description: Doors, window frames, built-in furniture installed.
